resources.string: Submit a Do Not Disturb request. Requires special access. On Android 15+ this changes only the OAssist rule: manual mode and other rules may retain restrictions. Success means request submission; observedGlobalFilter is a separate global filter snapshot, not confirmation that the request took effect.
true — request no interruptions; false — withdraw the OAssist request (does not disable other rules on Android 15+)
Request Do Not Disturb on (the OAssist rule on Android 15+)
Request Do Not Disturb off (only the OAssist rule on Android 15+; global restrictions may remain)
Do Not Disturb access is missing. Grant OAssist access in the system special access settings.
Could not confirm submission of the Do Not Disturb request. A change may have occurred; check the mode in system settings before retrying.

Request submitted to Android. Global filter at read time: all — unrestricted, none — no interruptions, priority — priority interruptions, alarms — alarms only, unknown — unavailable. This snapshot does not confirm that the request took effect and may change later.
The request affects only the OAssist rule. Manual mode and rules owned by others may keep Do Not Disturb active.
Check Do Not Disturb in system settings (open_settings, section=sound). Do not retry automatically: the snapshot may precede application of the request or reflect other rules.
